target.name: Locus Robotics
target.founder: Bruce Welty, Rick Faulk, Al Dekin

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series F → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.3x) to $2.0B last post money.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 9 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.0B - $2.3B.

data.narrative:
Locus Robotics, a Series F robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $438M to date, is valued at $2.0B post-money. The peer universe comprises 9 same-sector comparables at similar valuation tiers, including 8 private companies (Divergent, Exotec, Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and three others) and 1 public company, covering a valuation range of $1.0B to $2.3B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series F-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.3x to the $2.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $2.6B. Peer-median analysis across the 9 robotics comparables produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with peer values distributed between $1.0B and $2.3B. The peer set includes Divergent at Series E valued at $2.3B and Exotec at Series D valued at $2.0B as high-end anchors.

The two methods produce an implied range of $1.6B to $2.6B. Triangulating across both approaches yields a median of $2.1B, with low and high anchors at $1.4B and $3.0B respectively. Key uncertainties include stage-comparable granularity (peer stages range from Series B to Series E) and whether peer valuations reflect recent market repricing in frontier tech. The $2.0B current valuation sits near the triangulated median, supported by stage-progression methodology but moderated by peer-median inputs.
